newsitem.title: USA: IBM CFO to announce resignation - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IBM CFO to announce resignation - WSJ.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp was expected to announce Thursday the departure of Chief Financial Officer Richard Thoman to take over the reins of another company, the Wall Street Journal said.
But it said it could not immediately be determined where Thoman was going.
Thoman has been IBM's chief financial officer since 1995 and is considered the computer maker's No. 2 executive.

Observers believe Thoman has grown restless working in the shadows of Chairman and Chief Executive Louis Gerstner and is not hopeful that he can move up the ranks into Gerstner's position any time soon, the Journal reported Thursday.
